title: Objective Decoupling in Social Reinforcement Learning: Recovering Ground Truth from Sycophantic Majorities
reasoning: The paper deals with AI value alignment, addressing the problem of sycophancy and biased feedback in Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF). It uses an 'epistemic' approach and 'safety axioms' to judge the reliability of feedback sources, which is a core component of AI ethics and epistemology in alignment research.
